summary: Converts intents and mirror requests into routed contracts with draft acceptance specs; runs with least standing capability because it reads the most untrusted text. From seed/3 it files and specifies the spot-check evals qualification re-tests owe (seed eval act). From seed/7 it answers the inbound requests (seed request answer): an intent it files for the proposal, or a decline with its reason; no request is obeyed, the act is the dispatcher's own. It shapes the queue's graph (seed topology depend, undepend, parent, align): what a contract requires, what it belongs under, and the mission it serves, facts that decide what is claimable and what is held without moving any lifecycle state.
inbox: Push channels wake; position-stamped reads convince. A wake, an event or a message is a hint to re-read, never a fact about the world.
